quality_standards_and_policies.organizational_quality_policy: Adherence to corporate ISO 9001 quality management framework and continuous verification.
quality_standards_and_policies.applicable_industry_standards: IEEE 730 Software Quality Assurance Standards and CMMI Level 3 engineering guidelines.

quality_objectives_and_kpis.quality_goals_and_thresholds: Defect containment ratio of >= 95% prior to UAT release, with zero Severity 1 defects.
quality_objectives_and_kpis.continuous_improvement_objectives: Bi-weekly sprint retrospective audits and automated regression suites to maintain quality.

qa_and_qc_procedures.qa_process: Monthly independent PMO process compliance audits and code review checklists.
qa_and_qc_procedures.qc_testing_protocol: Static analysis linting, 85% automated unit test coverage, and formal end-to-end integration testing.
qa_and_qc_procedures.defect_management_process: Logging all defects in central issue tracker with strict SLAs: 4 hours for Severity 1, 24 hours for Severity 2.

quality_roles_and_review_gates.roles_and_responsibilities: Quality Assurance Lead oversees audits; Test Engineers execute verification test beds.
quality_roles_and_review_gates.review_gates_and_signoff_criteria: Formal quality gate approval required at Architecture Review, Sprint Release, and Stage Gate 4.
